meta.title: Magpie
meta.description: Magpie plugin development for DeepSeek Harness: a Magpie mode (agent preset) with four tools, eight skills, seven templates and a sandbox. magpie_doctor reports whether magpie, its gateway and its Bun plugin host are usable; magpie_plugin_new scaffolds a plugin package from a template for one of the seven kinds magpie loads (provider, gateway middleware, routing, tools, page, agent, async hooks); magpie_plugin_check checks a package the way magpie loads it and reports what would stop it loading or silently do something else; magpie_sandbox runs a magpie with its own HOME, config folder and gateway port so a plugin under development never touches the user's own sign-ins, providers or usage; magpie_templates lists the templates and the runtime each one runs in. The skills carry the judgement per kind: the interview that turns a wish into a shape, provider sign-in and quota hooks, the moejs limits for middleware and routings, tools and agents, pages in the window, sandbox testing, debugging, and release (npm, magpie:// links, registry.json entries, GitHub topics). Installing this bundle patches no shipped preset: it inserts a new one, so no other mode changes what it composes. The checks are static and read-only; they cannot prove a real vendor sign-in works, and Desktop keeps DSH inside app.asar, so comparing the copied preset block against DSH needs a readable copy.
